cases.name: same nested parent arithmetic
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price * items.quantity)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: ordinary object descendants share nested parent
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price + items.details.tax)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: cast cannot conceal a second nested parent
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price + shipping.cost::long)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: selection value and key require same nested parent
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED(LAST(items.price, shipping.cost)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: predicate requires same nested parent
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(items.price > 0 AND shipping.cost > 0) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: ordinary parent field capture rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.price * rate)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: ordinary parent alias capture rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL parent_alias = rate | EVAL picked = NESTED(SUM(items.quantity * parent_alias)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: separate wrappers may use different nested parents
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_parents | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(items.price > 0) AND NESTED_ANY(shipping.cost > 0) | KEEP id, picked
